mapper.select: SELECT v.id, j.brand, j.name, j.trim_name, j.powertrain, j.model_year, COALESCE(j.condition_code,'NEW') condition_code, COALESCE(j.class_code,j.body_type) class_code, j.fuel_code, j.seating_capacity, j.displacement_cc, j.price, j.price_before_incentive, j.efficiency_value, j.city_efficiency, j.highway_efficiency, COALESCE(j.efficiency_unit,CASE j.fuel_code WHEN 'ELECTRIC' THEN 'km/kWh' WHEN 'HYDROGEN' THEN 'km/kg' ELSE 'km/L' END) efficiency_unit, j.wheel_size_inch, j.image_url, j.source_name, j.source_url, FALSE is_example FROM managed_vehicles v JOIN JSON_TABLE(v.payload, '$' COLUMNS( brand VARCHAR(100) PATH '$.brand', name VARCHAR(100) PATH '$.model', trim_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.trim', powertrain VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.powertrain', model_year INT PATH '$.year' NULL ON ERROR, condition_code VARCHAR(20) PATH '$.condition_code', class_code VARCHAR(30) PATH '$.class_code', body_type VARCHAR(30) PATH '$.body_type', fuel_code VARCHAR(30) PATH '$.fuel', seating_capacity INT PATH '$.seats', displacement_cc INT PATH '$.displacement_cc', price DECIMAL(15,2) PATH '$.price', price_before_incentive DECIMAL(15,2) PATH '$.price_before_incentive', efficiency_value DECIMAL(10,3) PATH '$.efficiency', city_efficiency DECIMAL(10,3) PATH '$.city_efficiency', highway_efficiency DECIMAL(10,3) PATH '$.highway_efficiency', efficiency_unit VARCHAR(20) PATH '$.efficiency_unit', wheel_size_inch INT PATH '$.wheel_size_inch', image_url VARCHAR(500) PATH '$.image_url', source_name VARCHAR(100) PATH '$.source_name', source_url VARCHAR(1000) PATH '$.source_url' )) j ON TRUE WHERE v.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY j.price, v.id
